channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Nov 27
item.description:
157 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Open doors now take full explosive splash damage based on their actual colliders, aligning damage with closed doors and fixing previous under‑damage for open doors.

UI & Interaction

  • Fixed the undergarments button not responding to clicks.
  • Fixed UI clipping of counters for bandit camp, fishing village, and bandit camp food vendors, ensuring counters display correctly.
  • Fixed chat emoji videos that would continue playing until disconnect.
  • Fixed a memory leak that could occur when closing UI and prevented downed players from being unintentionally kicked from the UI.

Dog AI

  • Improved dog heel behavior for more responsive movement while preserving realistic acceleration and turning.
  • Fixed dog sniffing bugs: dogs no longer get confused when far from items, can now sniff sleeping bags, players, and animal corpses; also improved seek animation and hook sniff walk.
  • Enhanced dog fetch mechanics.
  • Improved dog free‑roam behavior: reduced exaggerated leaning, removed turning on the spot, and added idle animations when dogs stop moving.

Balloon Outpost

  • Shrunk the balloon platform size and gave it its own signal alarm, with tuned volume and pitch.
  • Added ability to type at the balloon console while its door is opening and added a humming sound to its computer.

Rust+ Integration & Connectivity

  • Fixed Rust+ pairing screen so you can attempt pairing even without push-enabled devices and now shows an error if the push fails.

Player Cosmetics & Customization

  • Resolved issue where tattoos could persist after a server wipe if the player was dead at the time.
  • Tattoo quality‑of‑life improvements (easier application/preview) and added the new artist stool furniture item.

Combat & Structures

  • Open doors now take full explosive splash damage based on their actual colliders, aligning damage with closed doors and fixing previous under‑damage for open doors.

Gameplay & World

  • Raid window timer now counts correctly, ensuring raids start and end as intended.
  • Tattoo chairs now have proper colliders, preventing players from falling through or getting stuck.

Stability

  • DLSS no longer hangs the GPU on startup, improving launch stability for users of the feature.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Network panel and F8 overlay now show proper units (kb, kb/s, ms, b/s) and prevent line wrapping, improving readability of stats.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Nov 26
item.description:
197 development commits

World & Environment

  • Tree respawn logic improved to refill missing trees, preserve grove shapes, and avoid overfilling.

Vehicles

  • Car chassis now stays networked at long distances, preventing it from disappearing before players can see it.

Stability & Networking

  • Fixed a null‑reference crash on the F1 Net page when connecting via Steamworks; the debug string now returns an empty string, preventing client and server crashes.

Outpost Extraction Overhaul

  • Each extraction raid now receives its own time‑of‑day and weather, advancing six time slots and rolling a weather entry from the mode’s table.
  • Snow jacket is now sold for 20 scrap in the supplies shop, making it affordable for cold‑weather raids.
  • UI and HUD for extraction mode have been revamped: aligned inventory, stash and supplier panels; updated compass markers; refreshed HUD vitals; extraction maps rendered as survey‑style prints with improved navigation; and a new balloon marker indicates extraction points.

Crafting & Resources

  • The composter loot panel now shows progress toward the next fertilizer batch.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Panels pie menu now plays its selection sounds correctly.
  • Player lookup commands now correctly require a name, preventing unintended matches.
  • Closing the F1 menu no longer blocks subsequent menu clicks.
  • Net panel (F1) now displays actual ping values and is restricted to admins; side panel auto‑closes when access is lost.
  • Wire tool info now appears in panels on the crosshair, giving clearer readouts.
  • Connect and session modals restored the map button and full header image, improving navigation.
  • CCTV bookmark arrows no longer cause accidental camera activation when clicking nearby.
  • CCTV station bookmarks can now be dragged to reorder, allowing custom organization.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Modern sprint movement changes improve sprint feel and speed.
  • Premium queue skip quickjoin fix reduces wait time for premium players.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Nov 25
item.description:
167 development commits

Combat & Weapons

  • Recoil duration reduced by 75% on most weapons, making sustained fire feel more controllable.

Movement & Controls

  • Strafing now cancels sprint, and a crouch‑strafe bug has been fixed.
  • Boat and cargo parenting bugs fixed: players no longer unintentionally transfer to cargo ships, exclusion zones prevent attachment to moving excavator arms, and ladder climbing from boats no longer drags players off.

Building & Structures

  • Gingerbread physics material added to low and half walls, affecting building physics for gingerbread structures.

Trading & Crate System

  • Tradable skin bundles now retain their tradeable status, fixing incorrect non‑tradable markings.
  • Crate generators are now correctly recognized as bundles, ensuring proper operation within the bundle system.

Tech Tree & UI

  • Tech‑tree shuffled with a new in‑editor graph editor and reorganised tier 1‑3 trees for Hardcore and Primitive modes; UI now opens up to eight times faster, cutting load time from ~1.2 s to ~0.15 s.

Boss & NPC Physics

  • Scrap King’s physics material changed to metal, altering its interactions and damage handling.

Customization

  • New console variable lets players hide all tattoos

Lighting & Visuals

  • Brightness transition at dawn and dusk is smoother
  • Night light now works correctly with the anti‑gamma fix
  • Added foreground and background floor geometry for night shadows to prevent gamma spikes; includes a toggle convar

Gameplay & Balance

  • Sprint mechanics have been updated to the modern movement system, changing acceleration and stamina behavior for faster, smoother running.
